verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi yaṁ evaṁ dantaṁ mahato atthāya saṁvattati yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, cittaṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single thing that, when it is tamed, is so very beneficial as the mind.

verses.pali: Cittaṁ, bhikkhave, dantaṁ mahato atthāya saṁvattatī”ti.
verses.english: A tamed mind is very beneficial.”
